facts.fact: Decree-law 2020-31 of the Head of Government, published in the Official Journal no. 54 of 10 June 2020, concerns electronic data exchange between public bodies and their users and between bodies; the held passages show only the title and preamble, not the provisions.
facts.system: Décret-loi n° 2020-31 (échange électronique des données entre les structures)
